description.en: Locate a heading by semantic role and prove its exact visible content.
description.id: Temukan heading berdasarkan semantic role lalu buktikan exact visible content-nya.

instructions.en:
# Read a Role Locator

A locator describes how the test recognizes its target when an action or assertion runs. In this controlled page, the level-one heading is meaningful semantic structure.

This is a role-locator warm-up, not a rule that role is always the answer. The chosen page signal must still match the test intent.

## Your task
1. Locate the level-one heading with `getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })`.
2. Use a web assertion to prove its exact text is `Welcome to Playwright`.
instructions.id:
# Baca Role Locator

Locator menjelaskan cara test mengenali target saat action atau assertion dijalankan. Di controlled page ini, level-one heading adalah semantic structure yang bermakna.

Ini latihan awal role locator, bukan rule bahwa role selalu menjadi jawaban. Page signal yang dipilih tetap harus sesuai dengan intent test.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan level-one heading dengan `getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })`.
2. Gunakan web assertion untuk membuktikan exact text-nya adalah `Welcome to Playwright`.

en: The target is semantic document structure: a level-one heading.
Create the locator with `page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })`.
Pass that locator to `expect(...).toHaveText(...)` with the exact expected content.
id: Target-nya adalah semantic document structure: level-one heading.
Buat locator dengan `page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })`.
Kirim locator itu ke `expect(...).toHaveText(...)` dengan exact expected content.

title.en: Choose a Role and Accessible Name

description.en: Identify one user-facing control by role and accessible name, then prove the action outcome.
description.id: Kenali satu user-facing control berdasarkan role dan accessible name, lalu buktikan outcome action-nya.

instructions.en:
# Choose a Role and Accessible Name

## Scenario
A visitor activates the `Sign Up` button. The page should then expose the status `Signed up!`.

`getByRole` reflects the control's semantic role. The accessible name distinguishes it from other buttons. A successful click is not the final evidence, so the scenario also needs a status assertion.

## Your task
1. Locate the button with role `button` and accessible name `Sign Up`.
2. Click that control.
3. Locate the status by role and assert its exact text is `Signed up!`.
instructions.id:
# Pilih Role dan Accessible Name

## Skenario
Visitor mengaktifkan button `Sign Up`. Setelah itu, halaman harus menampilkan status `Signed up!`.

`getByRole` menyatakan semantic role control. Accessible name membedakannya dari button lain. Click yang berhasil bukan final evidence, jadi skenario tetap membutuhkan status assertion.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan control dengan role `button` dan accessible name `Sign Up`.
2. Klik control tersebut.
3. Temukan status berdasarkan role lalu assert exact text-nya adalah `Signed up!`.

en: The action target is a button that users recognize as `Sign Up`.
Use `page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign Up' })` for the action.
After the click, use the status role and a text assertion to prove the result.
id: Action target-nya adalah button yang dikenali pengguna sebagai `Sign Up`.
Gunakan `page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign Up' })` untuk action.
Setelah click, gunakan status role dan text assertion untuk membuktikan hasilnya.

challenges.htmlContent: Join Us
challenges.solution:
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign Up' }).click();
await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toHaveText('Signed up!');

description.en: Locate non-interactive content by exact user-visible text and assert that it is visible.
description.id: Temukan non-interactive content berdasarkan exact user-visible text lalu assert bahwa content terlihat.

instructions.en:
# Assert Visible Result Text

## Scenario
The controlled page already shows the result of a completed order. The displayed words `Order complete` are the evidence to inspect.

Use `getByText` for user-visible, non-interactive content when the wording is part of the contract. For a button or link, prefer its role and accessible name. A string match is a substring by default, so use `exact: true` when a longer message should not count.

## Your task
1. Locate the exact visible text `Order complete` with `getByText`.
2. Assert that the matching content is visible.
instructions.id:
# Assert Teks Hasil yang Terlihat

## Skenario
Controlled page sudah menampilkan hasil order yang selesai. Wording `Order complete` adalah bukti yang perlu diperiksa.

Gunakan `getByText` untuk user-visible, non-interactive content saat wording menjadi bagian kontrak. Untuk button atau link, utamakan role dan accessible name. String match memakai substring secara default, jadi gunakan `exact: true` kalau pesan yang lebih panjang nggak boleh ikut cocok.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan exact visible text `Order complete` dengan `getByText`.
2. Assert bahwa content tersebut terlihat.

en: The target is result content, not an interactive control.
Use `page.getByText('Order complete', { exact: true })`.
Pass the locator to `expect(...).toBeVisible()`.
id: Target-nya adalah result content, bukan interactive control.
Gunakan `page.getByText('Order complete', { exact: true })`.
Kirim locator ke `expect(...).toBeVisible()`.

title.en: Locate Fields by Their Label Contract

description.en: Fill form controls through their associated labels and verify the entered value.
description.id: Isi form control lewat associated label lalu verifikasi value yang dimasukkan.

instructions.en:
# Locate Fields by Their Label Contract

A labelled field can be located through the relationship between the visible label and its control. This should survive a generated ID change while still exposing a broken label association.

## Your task
1. Fill the field labelled `Username` with `testuser`.
2. Fill the field labelled `Password` with any non-empty practice value.
3. Assert the Username field has value `testuser` with `toHaveValue`.

This exercise uses controlled data. Do not put real credentials in challenge code or reports.
instructions.id:
# Temukan Field dari Kontrak Label

Labelled field bisa ditemukan lewat relationship antara visible label dan control-nya. Kontrak ini seharusnya bertahan saat generated ID berubah, tapi tetap menunjukkan label association yang rusak.

## Tugas kamu
1. Isi field berlabel `Username` dengan `testuser`.
2. Isi field berlabel `Password` dengan practice value apa pun yang tidak kosong.
3. Assert Username field memiliki value `testuser` dengan `toHaveValue`.

Latihan ini memakai controlled data. Jangan memasukkan credential sungguhan ke challenge code atau report.

en: Use the associated visible label rather than the generated input ID.
Call `getByLabel(...).fill(...)` for both controlled fields.
Use `toHaveValue('testuser')` on the Username locator for the evidence.
id: Gunakan associated visible label, bukan generated input ID.
Panggil `getByLabel(...).fill(...)` untuk kedua controlled field.
Gunakan `toHaveValue('testuser')` pada Username locator sebagai buktinya.

description.en: Practice locating a legacy search field by placeholder without treating placeholder as a label.
description.id: Latih pencarian legacy search field berdasarkan placeholder tanpa menganggap placeholder sebagai label.

instructions.en:
# Use a Placeholder Fallback

## Scenario
This controlled legacy search field exposes only the placeholder `Search...`. The placeholder is enough for this optional locator drill, but it does not replace a proper accessible label.

In a product review, report the missing label or request a testability improvement rather than assuming a passing placeholder locator solves accessibility.

## Your task
1. Locate the input by placeholder `Search...`.
2. Fill it with `Playwright testing`.
3. Assert the field has that exact value.
instructions.id:
# Gunakan Placeholder sebagai Fallback

## Skenario
Controlled legacy search field ini hanya menyediakan placeholder `Search...`. Placeholder cukup untuk optional locator drill ini, tapi bukan pengganti proper accessible label.

Saat mereview produk, laporkan label yang hilang atau minta testability improvement. Placeholder locator yang pass nggak otomatis menyelesaikan accessibility.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan input berdasarkan placeholder `Search...`.
2. Isi dengan `Playwright testing`.
3. Assert field memiliki exact value tersebut.

en: The available legacy contract is the placeholder text inside the empty field.
Use `getByPlaceholder('Search...').fill('Playwright testing')`.
Use `toHaveValue` for the entered-value evidence.
id: Legacy contract yang tersedia adalah placeholder text di dalam field kosong.
Gunakan `getByPlaceholder('Search...').fill('Playwright testing')`.
Gunakan `toHaveValue` sebagai bukti value yang dimasukkan.

challenges.solution:
await page.getByPlaceholder('Search...').fill('Playwright testing');
await expect(page.getByPlaceholder('Search...')).toHaveValue('Playwright testing');

title.en: Use an Explicit Test ID Contract
title.id: Gunakan Test ID Contract yang Eksplisit

description.en: Use a developer-owned test ID for a technical counter while keeping the user action semantic.
description.id: Gunakan test ID milik developer untuk technical counter sambil menjaga user action tetap semantic.

instructions.en:
# Use an Explicit Test ID Contract

## Scenario
A customer activates `Add to Cart`. The technical cart counter has the supported test ID `cart-count` and should change from `0` to `1`.

A test ID is an engineering agreement, not proof of user-facing semantics. Use the button's role and accessible name for the action, then the agreed test ID for the counter that lacks a useful visible identity.

## Your task
1. Click `Add to Cart` by role and accessible name.
2. Locate the counter with `getByTestId('cart-count')`.
3. Assert its text becomes `1`.
instructions.id:
# Gunakan Test ID Contract yang Eksplisit

## Skenario
Customer mengaktifkan `Add to Cart`. Technical cart counter memiliki supported test ID `cart-count` dan harus berubah dari `0` menjadi `1`.

Test ID adalah engineering agreement, bukan bukti user-facing semantics. Gunakan role dan accessible name button untuk action, lalu agreed test ID untuk counter yang nggak punya visible identity yang berguna.

## Tugas kamu
1. Klik `Add to Cart` berdasarkan role dan accessible name.
2. Temukan counter dengan `getByTestId('cart-count')`.
3. Assert text-nya berubah menjadi `1`.

en: Keep the customer action user-facing: locate the Add to Cart button by role and name.
The counter's explicit engineering contract is `cart-count`.
Use `toHaveText('1')` on the test-ID locator for the result.
id: Jaga customer action tetap user-facing: temukan Add to Cart button berdasarkan role dan name.
Explicit engineering contract milik counter adalah `cart-count`.
Gunakan `toHaveText('1')` pada test-ID locator sebagai hasil.

0

await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to Cart' }).click();
await expect(page.getByTestId('cart-count')).toHaveText('1');

title.id: Susun Locator dari List ke Item

description.en: Narrow a semantic list to the one item identified by visible content.
description.id: Persempit semantic list ke satu item yang dikenali dari visible content.

instructions.en:
# Compose from List to Item

A composed locator starts with meaningful scope, then searches inside that scope. This controlled page has one menu list, and the item `Products` is the intended visible contract.

## Your task
1. Locate the list by role.
2. Within that list, locate its list items.
3. Filter for the item containing `Products`.
4. Assert the selected item has exact text `Products`.

Position is not the contract here, so do not choose the second item merely because it is currently second.
instructions.id:
# Susun Locator dari List ke Item

Composed locator dimulai dari meaningful scope, lalu mencari di dalam scope tersebut. Controlled page ini punya satu menu list, dan item `Products` menjadi intended visible contract.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan list berdasarkan role.
2. Di dalam list tersebut, cari list item-nya.
3. Filter item yang berisi `Products`.
4. Assert selected item memiliki exact text `Products`.

Posisi bukan kontraknya, jadi jangan memilih item kedua hanya karena saat ini kebetulan berada di urutan kedua.

en: Start with the semantic list so later matching stays inside that scope.
Chain `getByRole('listitem')` from the list and use `filter({ hasText: 'Products' })`.
Use an exact text assertion on the narrowed item.
id: Mulai dari semantic list supaya pencarian berikutnya tetap berada di scope tersebut.
Chain `getByRole('listitem')` dari list lalu gunakan `filter({ hasText: 'Products' })`.
Gunakan exact text assertion pada narrowed item.

description.en: Work with iframes using frameLocator.
description.id: Bekerja dengan iframe menggunakan frameLocator.

instructions.en:
# Frame Locators

## Concept
Access iframe content with `frameLocator()`. If content is inside an `<iframe>`, normal locators won't find it! You must first locate the frame, then find elements inside it.

## Code Example
```javascript
const frame = page.frameLocator('#my-iframe');
await frame.locator('button').click();
```

## Real World Scenario
If you try to find a credit card input field inside a Stripe payment element without entering the iframe first, Playwright will fail. `frameLocator` is the key to unlocking these embedded sandboxes.

## Your Task
1. Access the iframe (`#widget`).
2. Click the button inside.
3. Assert the result text is `'Button clicked!'`.
instructions.id:
# Locator Frame

## Concept
Akses konten iframe dengan `frameLocator()`. Jika konten berada di dalam `<iframe>`, locator normal tidak akan menemukannya! Anda harus terlebih dahulu menemukan frame tersebut, lalu menemukan elemen di dalamnya.

## Code Example
```javascript
const frame = page.frameLocator('#my-iframe');
await frame.locator('button').click();
```

## Real World Scenario
Jika Anda mencoba menemukan kolom input kartu kredit di dalam elemen pembayaran Stripe tanpa memasuki iframe terlebih dahulu, Playwright akan gagal. `frameLocator` adalah kunci untuk membuka sandbox yang tertanam ini.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Akses iframe (`#widget`).
2. Klik tombol di dalamnya.
3. Verifikasi teks hasilnya adalah `'Button clicked!'`.

en: When dealing with content in an iframe, you must first switch your focus to that specific internal frame.
Use 'frameLocator()' to get a handle on the iframe, then you can find elements inside it normally.
Define 'const frame = page.frameLocator('#widget');' then call frame.locator('button').click().
id: Saat berurusan dengan konten dalam iframe, Kamu harus terlebih dahulu mengalihkan fokus ke frame internal spesifik tersebut.
Gunakan 'frameLocator()' untuk mendapatkan handle pada iframe, lalu Kamu dapat menemukan elemen di dalamnya secara normal.
Definisikan 'const frame = page.frameLocator('#widget');' lalu panggil frame.locator('button').click().

description.en: Use a retried web assertion when the list size itself is the product contract.
description.id: Gunakan retried web assertion saat list size memang menjadi product contract.

instructions.en:
# Assert a Locator Collection

A locator may intentionally describe several elements when the collection itself is under test. Here, the controlled todo list should contain exactly five list items.

Use `toHaveCount` so Playwright retries the web assertion. Immediate snapshots such as `allTextContents()` are useful for inspection, but they are not the preferred way to assert a dynamically rendered list.

## Your task
Assert that `page.getByRole('listitem')` contains exactly `5` matching items.
instructions.id:
# Assert Locator Collection

Locator boleh sengaja menjelaskan beberapa elemen saat collection memang sedang diuji. Di sini, controlled todo list harus berisi tepat lima list item.

Gunakan `toHaveCount` supaya Playwright melakukan retry pada web assertion. Immediate snapshot seperti `allTextContents()` berguna untuk inspection, tapi bukan pilihan utama untuk meng-assert dynamically rendered list.

## Tugas kamu
Assert bahwa `page.getByRole('listitem')` berisi tepat `5` matching item.

en: The listitem locator is intentionally plural in this exercise.
Pass `page.getByRole('listitem')` directly to `expect`.
Use `toHaveCount(5)` for the retried collection assertion.
id: Listitem locator memang sengaja plural di latihan ini.
Kirim `page.getByRole('listitem')` langsung ke `expect`.
Gunakan `toHaveCount(5)` untuk retried collection assertion.

title.en: Scenario: Add the Exact In-Stock Product
title.id: Skenario: Tambahkan Exact Product yang In Stock

description.en: Narrow repeated product cards by exact identity and state before acting on one intended control.
description.id: Persempit repeated product card berdasarkan exact identity dan state sebelum melakukan action pada satu intended control.

instructions.en:
# Scenario: Add the Exact In-Stock Product

## Scenario
The grid contains `Widget Basic`, `Widget Pro`, and `Widget Pro Max`. Buttons repeat across cards. The test must add the exact `Widget Pro` card only when it shows `In Stock`, then prove the resulting status.

Use semantic descendants to express identity and state. A substring-only `hasText: 'Widget Pro'` can also match `Widget Pro Max`, and `first()` would hide ambiguity.

## Your task
1. Locate the product-card collection by role `article`.
2. Filter to the card containing a heading with exact accessible name `Widget Pro`.
3. Filter that card to one containing exact visible text `In Stock`.
4. Assert the narrowed card count is `1`.
5. Inside it, click `Add to Cart` by role and accessible name.
6. Assert the status has exact text `Added Widget Pro!`.
instructions.id:
# Skenario: Tambahkan Exact Product yang In Stock

## Skenario
Grid berisi `Widget Basic`, `Widget Pro`, dan `Widget Pro Max`. Button berulang di setiap card. Test harus menambahkan exact `Widget Pro` hanya saat card menunjukkan `In Stock`, lalu membuktikan resulting status.

Gunakan semantic descendant untuk menyatakan identity dan state. Substring-only `hasText: 'Widget Pro'` juga bisa cocok dengan `Widget Pro Max`, sedangkan `first()` hanya menyembunyikan ambiguitas.

## Tugas kamu
1. Temukan product-card collection berdasarkan role `article`.
2. Filter card yang memiliki heading dengan exact accessible name `Widget Pro`.
3. Filter card tersebut ke yang memiliki exact visible text `In Stock`.
4. Assert narrowed card count adalah `1`.
5. Di dalamnya, klik `Add to Cart` berdasarkan role dan accessible name.
6. Assert status memiliki exact text `Added Widget Pro!`.

en: Use `filter({ has: ... })` with an exact heading locator for the product identity.
Add a second `has` filter with exact `In Stock` text, then prove one card remains.
Locate Add to Cart inside that card and assert the status after the click.
id: Gunakan `filter({ has: ... })` dengan exact heading locator untuk product identity.
Tambahkan `has` filter kedua dengan exact text `In Stock`, lalu buktikan hanya satu card tersisa.
Cari Add to Cart di dalam card tersebut dan assert status setelah click.

description.en: Assert element visibility states.
description.id: Asert status visibilitas elemen.

instructions.en:
# toBeVisible & toBeHidden

## Concept
Check if elements are visible or hidden! Playwright's `toBeVisible()` and `toBeHidden()` assertions are the most common ways to verify the visual state of the UI.

## Code Example
```javascript
await expect(page.locator('#modal')).toBeVisible();
await expect(page.locator('.spinner')).toBeHidden();
```

## Real World Scenario
Before interacting with a pop-up, you must ensure it's actually there. Verifying that a "Success" box appears after saving, or that a "Loading" spinner disappears, is crucial for stable tests.

## Your Task
1. Click the "Show Modal" button using `getByRole`.
2. Assert that the modal is visible using `toBeVisible()` on `getByText('Modal Content')`.
instructions.id:
# toBeVisible & toBeHidden

## Concept
Periksa apakah elemen terlihat atau tersembunyi! Asersi `toBeVisible()` dan `toBeHidden()` dari Playwright adalah cara yang paling umum untuk memverifikasi status visual UI.

## Code Example
```javascript
await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible();
await expect(page.getByTestId('spinner')).toBeHidden();
```

## Real World Scenario
Sebelum berinteraksi dengan pop-up, Anda harus memastikan pop-up itu benar-benar ada. Memverifikasi bahwa kotak "Berhasil" muncul setelah menyimpan, atau spinner "Loading" menghilang, sangat penting untuk pengujian yang stabil.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Klik tombol "Show Modal" menggunakan `getByRole`.
2. Verifikasi bahwa modal terlihat menggunakan `toBeVisible()` pada `getByText('Modal Content')`.

en: Verify whether an element is visually present on the screen or hidden from sight.
Use the 'toBeVisible()' and 'toBeHidden()' assertions which handle the timing and visibility checks for you.
Click the 'Show Modal' button, then use expect(page.getByText('Modal Content')).toBeVisible() to verify it appeared.
id: Verifikasi apakah suatu elemen muncul secara visual di layar atau tersembunyi dari pandangan.
Gunakan asersi 'toBeVisible()' dan 'toBeHidden()' yang menangani pengecekan waktu dan visibilitas untuk Kamu.
Klik tombol 'Show Modal', lalu gunakan expect(page.getByText('Modal Content')).toBeVisible() untuk memverifikasi kemunculannya.

description.en: Assert element text content.
description.id: Asert konten teks elemen.

instructions.en:
# toHaveText

## Concept
Validate the text content of elements! Use `toHaveText()` for exact matches and `toContainText()` for partial matches. You can also use Regular Expressions for flexible validation.

## Code Example
```javascript
await expect(page.getByRole('heading')).toHaveText('Welcome');
await expect(page.getByText('hello')).toContainText(/hello/i);
```

## Real World Scenario
Did the user actually log in? The easiest check is often verifying the header says "Welcome, User" instead of just finding an element. Text assertions confirm the *content* of the page is correct.

## Your Task
1. Assert the heading (`getByRole('heading')`) has the exact text "Hello World".
2. Assert the paragraph (`p`) contains the text "Playwright".
instructions.id:
# toHaveText

## Concept
Validasi konten teks elemen! Gunakan `toHaveText()` untuk pencocokan eksak dan `toContainText()` untuk pencocokan parsial. Anda juga dapat menggunakan Regular Expressions untuk validasi yang fleksibel.

## Code Example
```javascript
await expect(page.getByRole('heading')).toHaveText('Welcome');
await expect(page.getByText('hello')).toContainText(/hello/i);
```

## Real World Scenario
Apakah pengguna benar-benar berhasil masuk? Pemeriksaan termudah sering kali memverifikasi header bertuliskan "Selamat Datang, Pengguna", bukan hanya menemukan elemen. Asersi teks mengonfirmasi *konten* halaman benar.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Verifikasi bahwa heading (`getByRole('heading')`) memiliki teks eksak "Hello World".
2. Verifikasi bahwa paragraf (`p`) mengandung teks "Playwright".

en: Ensure that the text displayed on the page matches exactly what you expect.
Use 'toHaveText()' for exact comparisons or 'toContainText()' (or Regex) if you only need to match part of the message.
Call expect(page.getByRole('heading')).toHaveText('Hello World') and check the paragraph with toContainText('Playwright').
id: Pastikan teks yang ditampilkan di halaman sesuai dengan apa yang Kamu harapkan.
Gunakan 'toHaveText()' untuk perbandingan eksak atau 'toContainText()' (atau Regex) jika Kamu hanya perlu mencocokkan sebagian pesan.
Panggil expect(page.getByRole('heading')).toHaveText('Hello World') dan cek paragrafnya dengan toContainText('Playwright').

challenges.htmlContent:
Hello World

Welcome to Playwright testing framework!
challenges.solution:
await expect(page.getByRole('heading')).toHaveText('Hello World');
await expect(page.getByText(/Welcome to Playwright/)).toContainText('Playwright');

description.en: Assert checkbox, disabled, and other states.
description.id: Asert status checkbox, disabled, dan status lainnya.

instructions.en:
# State Assertions

State assertions prove what a user can do, not just that an element exists. Identify controls by label or accessible role and name, then use web-first assertions to observe their state.

## Your Task
1. Check the `Accept Terms` checkbox by its label.
2. Assert it is checked.
3. Assert the `Submit` button is enabled.
instructions.id:
# Asersi Status

## Concept
Periksa status elemen interaktif! Gunakan asersi seperti `toBeChecked()`, `toBeDisabled()`, `toBeEnabled()`, dan `toBeEditable()` untuk memverifikasi logika dan batasan UI.

## Code Example
```javascript
await expect(page.getByLabel('Accept Terms')).toBeChecked();
```

instructions.en:
# toHaveAttribute

## Concept
Check element attributes! Use `toHaveAttribute()` to verify technical details like image sources, link destinations, or accessibility properties.

## Code Example
```javascript
await expect(page.locator('a')).toHaveAttribute('href', '/home');
await expect(page.locator('img')).toHaveAttribute('alt');
```

## Real World Scenario
Broken links and missing images are bad. But missing `alt` text is an accessibility violation. Attribute assertions let you verify specific technical details like these.

## Your Task
1. Assert the link (`a`) has an `href` attribute with value "/about".
2. Assert the image (`img`) has an `alt` attribute (the specific value doesn't matter for this check).

description.en: Continue test execution after assertion failures.
description.id: Lanjutkan eksekusi tes setelah kegagalan asersi.

instructions.en:
# Soft Assertions

## Concept
Continue test execution even after assertion failures! Regular hard assertions stop the test immediately on failure, while `expect.soft()` records the error and allows the test to continue.

## Code Example
```javascript
// Regular - stops on failure
await expect(locator).toHaveText('A');

// Soft - continues on failure
await expect.soft(locator).toHaveText('A');
```

## Real World Scenario
In a long form, if the first field has a typo, a hard assertion stops the test immediately. You never find out if the other 10 fields are also broken. Soft assertions let you check EVERYTHING and report all failures at once.

## Your Task
1. Use soft assertions (`expect.soft`) to check if `#name-status`, `#email-status`, and `#pass-status` are visible.
2. Ensure the test continues to check all three status elements even if one fails.
instructions.id:
# Soft Assertions

## Concept
Lanjutkan eksekusi tes bahkan setelah kegagalan asersi! Asersi keras (hard assertion) biasa akan segera menghentikan tes saat gagal, sedangkan `expect.soft()` mencatat kesalahan dan membiarkan tes tetap berjalan.

## Code Example
```javascript
// Regular - berhenti saat gagal
await expect(locator).toHaveText('A');

// Soft - lanjut meskipun gagal
await expect.soft(locator).toHaveText('A');
```

## Real World Scenario
Dalam formulir yang panjang, jika bidang pertama memiliki kesalahan penulisan (typo), asersi keras (hard assertion) segera menghentikan pengujian. Anda tidak pernah tahu apakah 10 bidang lainnya juga rusak. Soft assertions memungkinkan Anda memeriksa SEMUANYA dan melaporkan semua kegagalan sekaligus.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Gunakan soft assertion (`expect.soft`) untuk memeriksa apakah `#name-status`, `#email-status`, dan `#pass-status` terlihat.
2. Pastikan tes terus berlanjut untuk memeriksa ketiga elemen status tersebut meskipun salah satunya gagal.

en: Collect multiple verification errors at once instead of letting the first failure stop the entire test.
Use 'expect.soft()' for non-critical checks so that the rest of your assertions still run.
Wrap your status checks in expect.soft(...).toBeVisible() to report all missing elements in a single run.
id: Kumpulkan beberapa kesalahan verifikasi sekaligus daripada membiarkan kegagalan pertama menghentikan seluruh pengujian.
Gunakan 'expect.soft()' untuk pemeriksaan non-kritis sehingga sisa asersi Kamu tetap berjalan.
Bungkus pemeriksaan status Kamu dalam expect.soft(...).toBeVisible() untuk melaporkan semua elemen yang hilang dalam satu proses.

instructions.en:
# Scenario: Form Validation Suite

## Concept
Validating a registration form with multiple states requires a combination of visibility and state assertions. You'll need to check error messages, input requirements, and dynamic button states.

## Real World Scenario
Validating a "Sign Up" form is more than just success path. You must prove that it *rejects* bad data (security) and *guides* the user (UX). This test suite ensures the form behaves correctly in all states.

## Your Task
1. Check that the email error (`#email-error`) is visible initially.
2. Check that the password requirement (`.hint`) is visible.
3. Verify the "Register" button is currently **disabled** using `toBeDisabled()`.
4. Fill in a valid email (contains '@') and a valid password (8+ characters).
5. Verify the "Register" button becomes **enabled** using `toBeEnabled()`.
instructions.id:
# Skenario: Suite Validasi Formulir

## Concept
Memvalidasi formulir pendaftaran dengan beberapa status memerlukan kombinasi asersi visibilitas dan asersi status. Anda perlu memeriksa pesan kesalahan, persyaratan input, dan status tombol yang dinamis.

## Real World Scenario
Memvalidasi formulir "Daftar" lebih dari sekadar jalur sukses. Anda harus membuktikan bahwa formulir tersebut *menolak* data yang buruk (keamanan) dan *membimbing* pengguna (UX). Suite pengujian ini memastikan formulir berfungsi dengan benar di semua status.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Periksa bahwa email error (`#email-error`) terlihat pada awalnya.
2. Periksa bahwa persyaratan kata sandi (`.hint`) terlihat.
3. Verifikasi tombol "Register" saat ini **dinonaktifkan** menggunakan `toBeDisabled()`.
4. Isi email yang valid (mengandung '@') dan kata sandi yang valid (8+ karakter).
5. Verifikasi tombol "Register" menjadi **aktif** menggunakan `toBeEnabled()`.

en: Manage a complex form validation suite that involves multiple states and dependent UI changes.
Combine visibility, text, and state assertions to prove the form guides the user correctly through the process.
Check initial errors, verify the button starts as disabled, fill valid data, and assert the button becomes enabled.
id: Kelola suite validasi formulir kompleks yang melibatkan beberapa status dan perubahan UI yang dependen.
Gabungkan asersi visibilitas, teks, dan status untuk membuktikan formulir memandu pengguna dengan benar melalui proses tersebut.
Cek kesalahan awal, verifikasi tombol dimulai sebagai dinonaktifkan (disabled), isi data yang valid, dan pastikan tombol menjadi aktif (enabled).

description.en: Master different types of click interactions.
description.id: Kuasai berbagai jenis interaksi klik.

instructions.en:
# Click Actions

## Concept
Playwright provides the `click()` method to interact with elements. It automatically waits for the element to be visible and stable before clicking. Use `getByRole` for more resilient tests.

## Code Example
```javascript
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click();
await page.locator('.menu').click();
```

## Real World Scenario
Almost every interaction involves clicking. Whether it's submitting a form, adding an item to a shopping cart, or closing a modal dialog, reliable click actions are the heartbeat of E2E testing.

## Your Task
1. Click the increment button (`+`) 3 times.
2. Verify the counter text is `'3'` using `expect(locator).toHaveText(...)`.
instructions.id:
# Aksi Klik

## Concept
Playwright menyediakan metode `click()` untuk berinteraksi dengan elemen. Metode ini secara otomatis menunggu elemen menjadi terlihat dan stabil sebelum diklik. Gunakan `getByRole` untuk pengujian yang lebih tangguh.

## Code Example
```javascript
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click();
await page.locator('.menu').click();
```

## Real World Scenario
Hampir setiap interaksi melibatkan klik. Baik itu mengirimkan formulir, menambahkan item ke keranjang belanja, atau menutup dialog modal, tindakan klik yang andal adalah detak jantung pengujian E2E.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Klik tombol increment (`+`) sebanyak 3 kali.
2. Verifikasi teks counter adalah `'3'` menggunakan `expect(locator).toHaveText(...)`.

en: Focus on finding the specific action element that performs the calculation.
Use a locator that describes the element's purpose, like getByRole for a button.
Call the .click() method exactly as many times as requested, then use a 'toHaveText' assertion.
id: Fokuslah untuk menemukan elemen aksi spesifik yang melakukan perhitungan.
Gunakan locator yang mendeskripsikan tujuan elemen, seperti getByRole untuk tombol.
Panggil metode .click() tepat sebanyak yang diminta, lalu gunakan asersi 'toHaveText'.

# Fill Form Fields

Use `fill()` when the test needs to set a form control to a known value. It replaces the existing value and fires input events. Character-by-character typing is for behavior that specifically depends on individual key events, not the routine default. Locate fields by their labels so the test follows the same form contract as the user.

## Your Task
1. Fill the **Email** field with `'qa@test.com'`.
2. Fill the **Password** field with `'secret123'`.
3. Verify the email field has the value `'qa@test.com'` using a web-first value assertion.

# Isi Field Formulir

Gunakan `fill()` ketika test perlu mengatur kontrol formulir ke nilai yang sudah diketahui. Metode ini mengganti nilai lama dan memicu input event. Pengetikan karakter demi karakter digunakan hanya untuk perilaku yang memang bergantung pada setiap keyboard event, bukan sebagai default rutin. Temukan field berdasarkan label agar test mengikuti kontrak formulir yang sama dengan pengguna.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Isi field **Email** dengan `'qa@test.com'`.
2. Isi field **Password** dengan `'secret123'`.
3. Verifikasi field email memiliki nilai `'qa@test.com'` dengan web-first value assertion.

Targetkan kolom input menggunakan teks yang sesuai dengan label visual mereka di layar.
Gunakan .fill() untuk 'qa@test.com' dan 'secret123', lalu verifikasi email dengan 'toHaveValue'.

# Checkbox & Radio

## Concept
Use `check()` and `uncheck()` to toggle checkboxes and radio buttons. These methods ensure the element is in the desired state, regardless of its previous status.

## Code Example

```javascript
await page.getByLabel('I agree').check();
await page.getByLabel('Newsletter').uncheck();
```

2. Verify it is checked using `expect(locator).toBeChecked()`.
instructions.id:
# Checkbox & Radio

## Concept
Gunakan `check()` dan `uncheck()` untuk mengubah status checkbox dan tombol radio. Metode ini memastikan elemen berada dalam status yang diinginkan, apapun status sebelumnya.

## Code Example

```javascript
await page.getByLabel('I agree').check();
await page.getByLabel('Newsletter').uncheck();
```

## Real World Scenario
Sebelum pengguna dapat membuat akun, mereka hampir selalu harus mencentang kotak "Saya setuju dengan Syarat & Ketentuan".

## Tugas Kamu
1. Centang checkbox **Accept Terms & Conditions**.
2. Verifikasi bahwa itu sudah dicentang menggunakan `expect(locator).toBeChecked()`.

instructions.en:
# Keyboard Actions

## Concept
Playwright allows you to simulate keyboard events with `page.keyboard`. You can press specific keys, combinations, or even type natural sequences of characters.

## Code Example

```javascript
await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
await page.keyboard.press('Control+C');
```

## Real World Scenario
Submitting a search bar often happens by pressing "Enter" rather than clicking a button. Testing this behavior ensures the "natural" user flow works.

## Your Task
1. Type `'Playwright'` into the search input (use `getByPlaceholder`).
2. Press `'Enter'` using the keyboard.
3. Verify the result text (`#result`) is `'Searching for: Playwright'` using `expect(locator).toHaveText(...)`.
instructions.id:
# Aksi Keyboard

## Concept
Playwright memungkinkan Anda mensimulasikan event keyboard dengan `page.keyboard`. Anda dapat menekan tombol tertentu, kombinasi tombol, atau bahkan mengetik urutan karakter yang alami.

## Code Example

```javascript
await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
await page.keyboard.press('Control+C');
```

## Real World Scenario
Mengirimkan bilah pencarian sering kali dilakukan dengan menekan "Enter" daripada mengklik tombol. Menguji perilaku ini memastikan alur pengguna yang "alami" berfungsi.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Ketik `'Playwright'` ke dalam input pencarian (gunakan `getByPlaceholder`).
2. Tekan `'Enter'` menggunakan keyboard.
3. Verifikasi teks hasil (`#result`) adalah `'Searching for: Playwright'` menggunakan `expect(locator).toHaveText(...)`.

en: Simulate a physical user interaction where a specific key is pressed to submit the form.
After filling the search input, use the 'page.keyboard' API to trigger the submission.
Call page.keyboard.press('Enter') and assert that the result message is visible on the page.
id: Simulasikan interaksi pengguna fisik di mana kunci tertentu ditekan untuk mengirimkan formulir.
Setelah mengisi input pencarian, gunakan API 'page.keyboard' untuk memicu pengiriman.

instructions.en:
# Hover & Focus

## Concept
Some elements only become visible or interactable when you hover over them with the mouse or focus on them with the keyboard. Playwright provides `hover()` and `focus()` methods to simulate these states.

## Code Example
```javascript
await page.getByText('Menu Item').hover();
await page.getByLabel('Input Field').focus();
```

## Real World Scenario
Navigation menus often reveal submenus only on hover. You need to simulate this hover action to make the submenu visible before you can click anything inside it.

## Your Task
1. Hover over the "Products" menu item.
2. Verify the dropdown becomes visible by checking for the "Laptop" link.
instructions.id:
# Hover & Fokus

## Concept
Beberapa elemen hanya menjadi terlihat atau dapat berinteraksi saat Anda mengarahkan mouse (hover) di atasnya atau memfokuskan keyboard pada elemen tersebut. Playwright menyediakan metode `hover()` dan `focus()` untuk mensimulasikan status ini.

## Code Example
```javascript
await page.getByText('Menu Item').hover();
await page.getByLabel('Input Field').focus();
```

## Real World Scenario
Menu navigasi sering kali menampilkan submenu hanya saat di-hover. Anda perlu mensimulasikan tindakan hover ini agar submenu terlihat sebelum Anda dapat mengklik apa pun di dalamnya.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Hover di atas menu item "Products".
2. Verifikasi dropdown menjadi terlihat dengan memeriksa link "Laptop".

Use `setInputFiles()` to set a file input without automating the operating-system picker. In a real Playwright project, a string such as `tests/fixtures/resume.pdf` is a filesystem path and the file must exist. An in-memory payload is an alternative when no fixture file is needed.

Dalam project Playwright nyata, string seperti `tests/fixtures/resume.pdf` adalah path filesystem dan file tersebut harus tersedia. Payload in-memory menjadi alternatif jika fixture file tidak dibutuhkan.

Di browser playground ini, upload file simulasi `resume.pdf` melalui label **Upload Resume** dan periksa bahwa status berisi nama file tersebut.

instructions.en:
# Drag and Drop

## Concept
Perform complex mouse gestures easily with the `dragTo()` method. Playwright handles the sequence of mouse down, move, and up for you.

## Code Example

```javascript
await page.getByText('Source').dragTo(page.getByText('Target'));
```

## Real World Scenario
Kanban boards (like Trello/Jira) use drag-and-drop extensively to move tickets between columns. Testing this interaction ensures the "drop" event actually fires and updates the UI.

## Your Task
1. Drag the element with text `'Drag'`.
2. Drop it into the element with text `'Zone'`.
3. Verify the zone text becomes `'Dropped!'` using `expect(page.getByText('Dropped!')).toBeVisible()`.
instructions.id:
# Seret dan Lepas

## Concept
Lakukan gerakan mouse yang kompleks dengan mudah menggunakan metode `dragTo()`. Playwright menangani urutan mouse down, move, dan up untuk Anda.

## Code Example

```javascript
await page.getByText('Source').dragTo(page.getByText('Target'));
```

## Real World Scenario
Papan Kanban (seperti Trello/Jira) menggunakan seret-dan-lepas secara ekstensif untuk memindahkan tiket antar kolom. Menguji interaksi ini memastikan event "drop" benar-benar terjadi dan memperbarui UI.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Seret elemen dengan teks `'Drag'`.
2. Jatuhkan ke dalam elemen dengan teks `'Zone'`.
3. Verifikasi teks zona menjadi `'Dropped!'` menggunakan `expect(page.getByText('Dropped!')).toBeVisible()`.

en: Imagine the sequence of picking up an item and placing it exactly where it needs to go.
Use the '.dragTo()' method which automatically handles the complex mouse movements for you.
Call getByText('Drag').dragTo(page.getByText('Zone')) and verify that the 'Dropped!' message is visible.
id: Bayangkan urutan mengambil item dan meletakkannya tepat di tempat yang seharusnya.
Gunakan metode '.dragTo()' yang secara otomatis menangani gerakan mouse yang kompleks untuk Kamu.
Panggil getByText('Drag').dragTo(page.getByText('Zone')) dan pastikan pesan 'Dropped!' terlihat.

description.en: Select elements inside iframes.
description.id: Pilih elemen di dalam iframe.

instructions.en:
# Working with Frames

## Concept
If content is inside an `<iframe>`, normal locators won't find it! You must first locate the frame using `frameLocator()`, and then use that frame to find elements inside it.

## Code Example

```javascript
// 1. Locate the frame
const frame = page.frameLocator('iframe');

// 2. Locate element by role/text inside the frame
await frame.getByRole('button').click();
```

## Real World Scenario
Embedded payment forms (like Stripe) or third-party widgets often live in iframes for security. You must switch context to interaction with them.

## Your Task
1. Locate the iframe.
2. Find the input inside it using `getByPlaceholder('Card Number')`.
3. Fill it with `'1234'`. 
4. Verify the value using `toHaveValue()`.
instructions.id:
# Bekerja dengan Frame

## Concept
Jika konten berada di dalam `<iframe>`, locator normal tidak akan menemukannya! Anda harus terlebih dahulu menemukan frame tersebut menggunakan `frameLocator()`, lalu menggunakan frame tersebut untuk menemukan elemen di dalamnya.

## Code Example

```javascript
// 1. Temukan frame
const frame = page.frameLocator('iframe');

// 2. Temukan elemen berdasarkan role/text di dalam frame
await frame.getByRole('button').click();
```

## Real World Scenario
Formulir pembayaran tertanam (seperti Stripe) atau widget pihak ketiga sering kali berada dalam iframe demi keamanan. Anda harus mengganti konteks untuk berinteraksi dengan mereka.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Temukan iframe.
2. Temukan input di dalamnya menggunakan `getByPlaceholder('Card Number')`.
3. Isi dengan `'1234'`.
4. Verifikasi nilai menggunakan `toHaveValue()`.

en: Elements inside a sub-page (iframe) are isolated from the main page's locator searches.
Use 'frameLocator()' to gain access to the iframe's content before trying to find the input inside it.
Create a 'const frame = page.frameLocator('iframe');' then use frame.getByPlaceholder(...) to fill and verify.
id: Elemen di dalam sub-halaman (iframe) terisolasi dari pencarian locator halaman utama.
Gunakan 'frameLocator()' untuk mendapatkan akses ke konten iframe sebelum mencoba menemukan input di dalamnya.
Buat 'const frame = page.frameLocator('iframe');' lalu gunakan frame.getByPlaceholder(...) untuk mengisi dan memverifikasi.

description.en: Find a row by text and interact with its internals.
description.id: Temukan baris berdasarkan teks dan berinteraksi dengan bagian dalamnya.

instructions.en:
# Dynamic Tables

## Concept
When dealing with dynamic data, you often need to find a container (like a table row) that contains specific text, and then find an interactive element inside that container using `filter()`.

## Code Example

```javascript
const row = page.locator('tr').filter({ hasText: 'Alice' });
await row.locator('.edit-btn').click();
```

## Real World Scenario
Admin dashboards often list users or orders. You can't just click the "third edit button" because sorting might change. You need to find the *user named Alice* and click *her* edit button.

## Your Task
1. Find the row containing "Project X" (`.task-row`).
2. Click the "Complete" button inside that row.
3. Verify the row status (`.status`) becomes `'Done'` using `expect(locator).toHaveText(...)`.
instructions.id:
# Tabel Dinamis

## Concept
Saat berurusan dengan data dinamis, Anda sering kali perlu menemukan kontainer (seperti baris tabel) yang berisi teks tertentu, lalu menemukan elemen interaktif di dalam kontainer tersebut menggunakan `filter()`.

## Code Example

```javascript
const row = page.locator('tr').filter({ hasText: 'Alice' });
await row.locator('.edit-btn').click();
```

## Real World Scenario
Dasbor admin sering mencantumkan pengguna atau pesanan. Anda tidak bisa hanya mengklik "tombol edit ketiga" karena penyortiran mungkin berubah. Anda perlu menemukan *pengguna bernama Alice* dan mengklik tombol edit *miliknya*.

## Tugas Kamu
1. Temukan baris yang berisi "Project X" (`.task-row`).
2. Klik tombol "Complete" di dalam baris itu.
3. Verifikasi status baris (`.status`) menjadi `'Done'` menggunakan `expect(locator).toHaveText(...)`.

en: Find a specific row by a unique piece of text it contains, then look for a button within just that row.
Use the '.filter({ hasText: ... })' method to isolate the correct row from all other rows.
Locate the row with 'Project X', click the 'Complete' button inside it, and verify its local status text.
id: Temukan baris spesifik berdasarkan teks unik yang dikandungnya, lalu cari tombol hanya di dalam baris tersebut.
Gunakan metode '.filter({ hasText: ... })' untuk memisahkan baris yang benar dari semua baris lainnya.
Temukan baris dengan 'Project X', klik tombol 'Complete' di dalamnya, dan verifikasi teks status lokalnya.

description.en: Complete a full checkout flow using accessibility-first locators.
description.id: Selesaikan alur checkout lengkap menggunakan locator berbasis aksesibilitas.

instructions.en:
# Scenario: E-Commerce Checkout

## Concept
A complete E2E flow involves chaining multiple interactions: finding elements, entering data, and verifying the final outcome. Using accessibility-first locators (`getByRole`, `getByLabel`) makes these flows more resilient to UI changes.

## Code Example
```javascript
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Purchase' }).click();
await page.getByLabel('Address').fill('123 Main St');
await expect(page.locator('#receipt')).toBeVisible();
```

## Real World Scenario
Using explicit IDs makes tests brittle. If a developer changes `#qty` to `#quantity-input`, your test fails. But if they remove the "Quantity" label, *users* can't use the form either. Testing against the label ensures the app is usable.

## Your Task
1.  **Add to Cart**: Click the button with name "Add to Cart".
2.  **Update Qty**: Fill the input labeled "Quantity" with `'3'`.
3.  **Shipping**: Check the checkbox labeled "Express Shipping".
4.  **Checkout**: Click the button named "Checkout".
5.  **Verify**: Confirm the confirmation message (`#confirmation`) contains `'3 items (Express)'`.
instructions.id:
# Skenario: Checkout E-Commerce

## Concept
Alur E2E yang lengkap melibatkan perangkaian beberapa interaksi: menemukan elemen, memasukkan data, dan memverifikasi hasil akhir. Menggunakan locator berbasis aksesibilitas (`getByRole`, `getByLabel`) membuat alur ini lebih tangguh terhadap perubahan UI.

## Code Example
```javascript
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Purchase' }).click();
await page.getByLabel('Address').fill('123 Main St');
await expect(page.locator('#receipt')).toBeVisible();
```

## Real World Scenario
Menggunakan ID eksplisit membuat pengujian menjadi rapuh. Jika pengembang mengubah `#qty` menjadi `#quantity-input`, pengujian Anda gagal. Namun jika mereka menghapus label "Quantity", *pengguna* juga tidak dapat menggunakan formulir tersebut. Pengujian terhadap label memastikan aplikasi dapat digunakan.

## Tugas Kamu
1.  **Add to Cart**: Klik tombol dengan nama "Add to Cart".
2.  **Update Qty**: Isi input berlabel "Quantity" dengan `'3'`.
3.  **Shipping**: Centang checkbox berlabel "Express Shipping".
4.  **Checkout**: Klik tombol bernama "Checkout".
5.  **Verifikasi**: Konfirmasikan pesan konfirmasi (`#confirmation`) berisi `'3 items (Express)'`.

en: Chain together a series of realistic user steps: adding to cart, updating numbers, and checking out.
Prioritize using accessibility-first locators like getByRole and getByLabel for every step of the flow.
Add to cart, set Quantity to '3', check Express Shipping, and click Checkout. Assert the confirmation message.
id: Rangkai serangkaian langkah pengguna yang realistis: menambahkan ke keranjang, memperbarui angka, dan checkout.
Prioritaskan penggunaan locator accessibility-first seperti getByRole dan getByLabel untuk setiap langkah alur.
Tambahkan ke keranjang, set Quantity ke '3', centang Express Shipping, dan klik Checkout. Lakukan asersi pesan konfirmasi.

title.en: Wait for the Outcome, Not the Clock

description.en: Replace a fixed delay with an assertion that waits for the save result users can observe.
description.id: Ganti fixed delay dengan assertion yang menunggu hasil save yang dapat diamati pengguna.

instructions.en:
# Wait for the Outcome

Click the `Save profile` button using its role and accessible name. The application updates the status asynchronously. Prove that the status eventually contains `Profile saved` with a web-first text assertion. Do not use `waitForTimeout`; the test must wait for meaning, not elapsed time.
instructions.id:
# Tunggu Hasil

Klik button `Save profile` menggunakan role dan accessible name. Aplikasi memperbarui status secara asynchronous. Buktikan status akhirnya berisi `Profile saved` dengan web-first text assertion. Jangan gunakan `waitForTimeout`; test harus menunggu makna, bukan waktu yang berlalu.

en: Locate the status by role after clicking.
`toHaveText` retries until the asynchronous update appears.
id: Temukan status berdasarkan role setelah klik.
`toHaveText` melakukan retry sampai update asynchronous muncul.
